scripts.check: bun run contract:build && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p scripts
scripts.migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.migrate:alpha: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env alpha
scripts.seed:staging: bun run contract:build && bun scripts/seed.ts --env staging
scripts.seed:alpha: bun run contract:build && bun scripts/seed.ts --env alpha
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run contract:build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:alpha: bun run contract:build && wrangler deploy --env alpha
scripts.validate: bun run contract:build && bun run check && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run contract:test
scripts.version:release: changeset version && node scripts/sync-version.mjs && bun install --lockfile-only && bun run format
